name: headout-pm-os
description: Headout PM OS — the shared operating system for the Headout product team. Bundles 9 specialist PM skills (problem framing → ideation → data analysis → prototyping → spec writing → L1 review → experiment design → implementation planning) plus the team's durable context (CLAUDE.md, org structure, pod scopes, glossary, project history). Skills load context via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} so the bundled CLAUDE.md and memory/ files resolve correctly regardless of the user's working directory.
